errors_i_made_this_round.error: P-3's criterion required the errata on all three cards
errors_i_made_this_round.why: the withdrawn allegation was made ABOUT M31's record, so only M31's binding carries an errata block. M29/M30 legitimately have none -- their records never asserted the divergence. Requiring an errata on a card that never made the claim is a criterion that cannot pass -- the same family as round 63's P-6 (skill trap #31).
errors_i_made_this_round.correction: require the errata on the claimant card; require the others only to be consistent
errors_i_made_this_round.verified: NC-6 restores the bad criterion and P-3 correctly goes red again
errors_i_made_this_round.lesson: 'X appears in the three places that hold it' and 'X appears in the one place that produced it' are different criteria; when the former fails, it is usually not because X is missing but because X should not be in all three
